ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   D. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   D. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   B. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   C. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.
   C. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Tawhid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Shirk of Shirk Shirk and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. D — Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. B — Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Significance of Tawhid; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Shirk of Shirk Shirk; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
